subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Runtime helper objects and free functions for MTS mesh/texture file loading, game-device state notification, scene-graph and resource linked lists, raster span fills and transparent image copies, and generic teardown helpers; most owners are unidentified.

summary: This packet covers a heterogeneous set of runtime helper functions and objects: (1) an MTS mesh/texture file loader cluster sharing a global read cursor (0x008B8F3C) and two default-header initializers; (2) four thunks funneling a function/global value through the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper (0x00587B3E); (3) three settings setters that dispatch value changes to the global game-device object (0x008B89A0) through vtable+252; (4) three distinct linked-list containers (scene-graph child list, resource list, scene-node named list) with incompatible node layouts; (5) four raster span-fill primitives and four transparent image/row-copy helpers sharing global mask state (0x005DD804 / 0x005DD814 / 0x005DD844); (6) a frustum-visibility classifier, a six-field record setter, several single-field getters/setters, and conditional-freed teardown helpers. No function owner is proven by the packet; all classes are GUESS groupings and the remaining functions keep UnknownObject ownership.

function_roles.role: Mode-based updater of the global read-cursor dword 0x008B8F3C (modes: 0=set, 1=add, 2=subtract-from 0x008B8F38).
Getter returning the global read-cursor dword 0x008B8F3C, used as base cursor position by the MTS file parser.
Getter returning the dword at this+0x0; argument a2 unused.
Unlinks a node from the scene-graph child doubly linked list whose head is at this+0x204; node prev at +0x140, next at +0x10; advances the head on head removal.
Thunk calling BooleanToIntConversion with the address of InitializationLoop256 (0x0054C2A0) cast to int; returns its result.
Thunk calling BooleanToIntConversion with the global value at 0x0054C300 cast to int; returns its result.

Default MTS texture-header initializer: copies the magic string from 0x005DBFC0 into the object, clears fixed field blocks and sets constant header values; called right after the loader allocates the output buffer.
Conditional float setter: writes a2/a3 into this+0xF4/+0xF8 only when they differ from the -1.0 sentinel constant 0x0059E428.
Classifies an AABB against frustum planes and writes visibility state (1 visible / 2 culled / 4 intersecting) into the state word at this+0x14, gated on the plane count at this+0xFC.
Getter returning the dword at byte offset 4 of the object argument a2; a1 and a3 unused.

Default MTS mesh-header initializer: copies the magic string from 0x005DBF50 into the object, clears fixed field blocks and sets constant header values; called right after the loader allocates the intermediate mesh buffer.
Loops 1024 times over 24-byte-strided slots of the buffer at 0x008C5F48, calling ShortComputation_8e00 on each slot; returns the last call's result.
Thunk calling BooleanToIntConversion with the global value at 0x0054EAD0 cast to int; returns its result.
Scales float a2 by the 2.55 constant at 0x005B8988, rounds via CRTFtol, replicates the byte across all channels (16843009) and stores it at this+0x68.
Stores argument a2 into the dword at this+0x60 and returns the stored value.
Computes 1.0/a2 using the 1.0 constant at 0x0059E43C and stores the reciprocal at this+0x58.
Walks the scene-node named-child list at this+0x13C; for each node whose name matches the key, clears bit 0x20000 on its flags and calls AudioFlagSet on the node.
Calls BinkClose (imported at 0x0059E338) on the Bink handle stored at this+0x0 and returns 0.
Orders span endpoints ascending and fills a 16-bit span via F_16BitShortArrayFill.
Orders span endpoints ascending and fills a strided span via ShortArrayFillWithStride.
Normalizes boundary arguments and fills a contiguous horizontal run via ArrayFillWithValue.
Normalizes boundary arguments and fills a strided horizontal pixel run via PixelFillWithStride.
Maps enum a2 (0/1/2) to dispatch value (1/3/2) and calls the global object 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 13, value); caches a2 in this+0x38.
Maps enum a2 (0/1/2) to dispatch value (1/3/2) and calls the global object 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 14, value); caches a2 in this+0x3C.
Change-guarded setter: when a2 differs from -1 and from this+0x2C, dispatches (*this, 11, a2) to global 0x008B89A0 vtable+252 and stores a2 in this+0x2C.
Scales a float argument by the global factor 0x005DC164 and casts the product to int (truncation toward zero).
CPUID/RDTSC probe: toggles EFLAGS ID bit to detect CPUID support, computes elapsed TSC into the caller dword pair *a1/*a2, and writes the CPUID leaf-0 vendor string to a3 when supplied.
Calls BooleanToIntConversion with the MainLoopHeartbeat512 address (0x005568E0) cast to int; candidate callback registration.
Copies six DWORD/pointer arguments a2..a7 into consecutive fields this+0x4..this+0x18 and returns 0.
Walks the resource list at this+0x1518, unlinks the node matching a2 (node prev at +0x1C, next at +0x20), and advances the head on a head removal.
Clears the byte flag at this+0x58 to 0 and returns 0; called by sub_5454A0.
Calls GlobalMemoryStatus with a 32-byte _MEMORYSTATUS buffer and discards the results; called during UI-system global initialization.
Copies a fixed 0xA0-byte block from global 0x008B8F04 into destination a1; returns void.

Row-wise keyed copy: stores the key word a7 to 0x005DD804; takes a fast block-copy path when a7 is 0xFFFF and row width is a multiple of 8, otherwise copies word-by-word skipping destination words equal to the key.
16-bit transparent blit: stores the transparent color to 0x005DD804; per-pixel path skips pixels equal to it, while the aligned 0xFFFF fast path copies 64-bit chunks.

24-bit transparent blit: stores the masked transparent color to 0x005DD804 and scanline byte width to 0x005DD814; bulk-copies whole scanlines when transparent color is 0xFFFFFF, else skips pixels equal to it.

Mode-dependent row copy on the audio playback path: full block copy when a7 == -1, else copies dwords differing from the mask; records mode flag, mask and per-row count into 0x005DD844 / 0x005DD804 / 0x005DD814.
Conditional teardown: frees this+0x1AC via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, zeroes the field, and returns the prior pointer; used in DirectX resource teardown.
Conditional single-field free: frees this+0x4 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null and returns the wrapper result; used as a sub-object teardown step.

classes.name: MtsReadBufferState
classes.responsibility: Owns the global read-cursor dword 0x008B8F3C used while parsing MTS mesh/texture file payloads; provides a mode-based cursor updater and a cursor getter.

classes.name: MtsHeaderInitializer
classes.responsibility: Stamps default MTS texture/mesh headers after the loader allocates their buffers: copies the MTS magic string into the object start, clears fixed field blocks and sets constant header values (1065353216, 1176256512, 6).

classes.name: GameDeviceSettingNotifier
classes.responsibility: Settings setters that dispatch value changes for this object to the shared game-device object at 0x008B89A0 through its vtable entry +252, skipping no-change/-1 updates and caching the last accepted value per slot.

classes.name: SceneGraphChildList
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked child list of a scene-graph object; supports node unlink during scene-graph cleanup.

classes.name: ResourceCascadeList
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked resource list (head at this+0x1518) supporting unlink-by-pointer-match during resource cascade cleanup.

classes.name: SceneNodeNamedChildList
classes.responsibility: Named child list of a scene-node: string-keyed lookup that clears flag bit 0x20000 on matching nodes and triggers an audio flag update.

classes.name: SceneNodeOverrideFloats
classes.responsibility: Optional float override fields on a scene-node object; each override argument is honored only when it differs from the -1.0 sentinel.

classes.name: FrustumVisibilityState
classes.responsibility: Per-object visibility state: the state word at this+0x14 records AABB-vs-frustum classification (1 visible / 2 culled / 4 intersecting), with the plane count at this+0xFC gating the culling pass.

classes.name: SpanFillPrimitives
classes.responsibility: Raster span/run fill primitives: normalize boundary endpoints to ascending order and delegate to 16-bit, strided or horizontal-run fill helpers.

classes.name: SixFieldRecord
classes.responsibility: Generic record whose first six payload fields (offsets 0x4..0x18) are written in one call; exact meaning depends on caller 0x0055BC00.

classes.name: ImageCopyEngine
classes.responsibility: Image/row copy helpers sharing global transparent-color/mask state: 16/24-bit transparent blits, keyed row copy, and masked audio row copy, all driven through the shared globals 0x005DD804 / 0x005DD814 / 0x005DD844.

state_machines.name: AabbFrustumVisibilityClassification
transitions: Classification recomputed on each call: a plane with all 8 AABB corners outside (mask == 255) selects CULLED; a partial outside mask selects INTERSECTING; no outside corner on any plane keeps VISIBLE.

interfaces.name: BooleanToIntConversionThunks
interfaces.purpose: Module-level thunks that call the shared helper 0x00587B3E with an integer formed from a function address or data global and return its result; candidate callback-registration or vtable-initialization pattern with unresolved side effects.

interfaces.name: ConditionalFieldFreeHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Teardown helpers that free a single this-field through the shared deallocation wrapper 0x00587BCF when the field is non-null.

compatibility_contracts.name: MtsReadCursorGlobalSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Preserve the global read cursor at 0x008B8F3C with mode-based updates (0=set, 1=add, 2=subtract using the companion global 0x008B8F38); the MTS file load path reads it as the base cursor position while parsing mesh/texture payloads.

compatibility_contracts.name: MtsDefaultHeaderValues
compatibility_contracts.description: MTS texture and mesh headers must default to: MTS magic string at offset 0, dword index 6 = 1065353216, dword index 62/38 = 1176256512, dword index 63/39 = 6, with fixed zeroed field blocks (texture: indices 55..81 plus regions at byte 28 and 124; mesh: indices 31..57 plus region at byte 28).

compatibility_contracts.name: GameDeviceVtable252Dispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: The global game-device object at 0x008B89A0 must expose a callable vtable entry at offset +252 taking (object_id, param_id, value); param ids 13 and 14 encode enum 0/1/2 to dispatch values 1/3/2, and slot 11 carries generic value-change notifications.

compatibility_contracts.name: TransparentImageCopySemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: 16/24-bit blit and row-copy helpers treat a pixel equal to the shared transparent color / mask (global 0x005DD804) as 'leave destination unchanged'; a transparent color of 0xFFFF (16-bit) or 0xFFFFFF (24-bit) with aligned width selects an unguarded bulk fast path; scanline width is stored at 0x005DD814 and the full-copy mode flag at 0x005DD844.

compatibility_contracts.name: DoublyLinkedNodeLayouts
compatibility_contracts.description: Two distinct doubly linked list node layouts are evidenced and must not be unified: scene-graph child list (node prev at +0x140 / next at +0x10, container head at +0x204) and resource list (node prev at +0x1C / next at +0x20, container head at +0x1518).

compatibility_contracts.name: DeallocationWrapperContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Teardown helpers release heap fields through the shared wrapper 0x00587BCF and null the field after freeing; callers depend on the freed-pointer return value.

unresolved: Owners are UNKNOWN for most functions; the classes above are GUESS groupings based on shared globals, shared callers, or identical shapes, not proven C++ classes.
Global 0x008B8F38 (cursor base used by GlobalStateVariableSetter mode 2) is read but its producer is unknown.
Texture vs mesh MTS header layouts use different field indices (texture 55..81/62/63, mesh 31..57/38/39); whether they are two views of one struct or two distinct structs is unresolved.
BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) thunks: whether 0x0054C2A0 / 0x0054C300 / 0x0054EAD0 / 0x005568E0 are function pointers or data values, and what the helper's side effects are, is unresolved.
AABB corner and frustum plane layouts (corners at a3+8, planes at a2+260) are inferred from pointer arithmetic, not named fields.
Scene-node named-list node layout (name at node[7]+28, next at node[9], flags at node[1]) is prose-mapped; the this-relative offsets 0x164 / 0x17C / 0x184 are not statically proven.
The 0xFF00000000005412 global write is an extraction artifact of the GlobalMemoryStatus import thunk, not a real data write.
this+0x58 is rewritten to 0 on every call of 0x0055D2E0, so an external poke does not persist.
The three GameDeviceSettingNotifier methods may belong to different objects; common ownership is not proven by the packet.
The 6-DWORD (24-byte) stride at 0x008C5F48 in F_1024xBatchCallLoop implies a fixed record whose layout is unconfirmed; only the last call's result is returned.
Pixel format, stride units and the meaning of fill arguments (a1..a6) of the span/blit helpers depend on caller image layouts not present in this packet.
QueryCpuTscDeltaAndVendor's prelabel 'structural twin of FloatClamp' (DERIVED) is not corroborated by the raw source, which is a CPUID/RDTSC probe.
In KeyedRowCopy the general-path comparison key becomes 2*a5 when a7 == 0xFFFF; the reason is unresolved.
The high bits of the frustum visibility state word (preserved by mask 0xFFFFFFF8) are undocumented.
The -1.0 sentinel in SceneNodeOverrideFloats means 'leave the field unchanged' by inference from the guard structure; the caller's interpretation of the override values is not evidenced.
Whether GetDwordFieldAtOffset0x4 and SixFieldRecord's field 0x4 refer to the same object type is not proven; offsets on unrelated bases are not merged.
